product.summary: BlueWallet mobile Bitcoin wallet for iOS and Android with user-controlled keys.
product.notes: First-party BlueWallet source history shows the mobile app in a store-versioned release lineage during 2018, including store version 1.2.0 with iOS bundle/build metadata on 2018-05-12. WLR records year precision only because the reviewed history does not establish a defensible exact initial public-release day.

events.title: BlueWallet hosted lndhub.io Lightning service shut down
events.description: BlueWallet sunset its hosted lndhub.io Lightning service, ending new wallet creation and refill support before the May 31, 2023 shutdown while leaving regular Bitcoin wallets unaffected.
events.notes: BlueWallet continued to support self-hosted LndHub and its self-custody Bitcoin wallet; this event does not represent a BlueWallet shutdown.

events.title: BlueWallet v7.0.9 fixed preferred Electrum server persistence
events.description: BlueWallet v7.0.9 fixed the preferred Electrum server persistence issue tracked as #7532, where a saved custom preferred server could be replaced by a suggested server after app restarts on the documented iOS reproductions.
events.notes: This is recorded as a software fix, not a vulnerability or exploit. WLR scopes the event only to BlueWallet Mobile because the reviewed reproductions are iOS/mobile; Desktop impact, server compromise, an affected pre-fix version range, and fund loss are not inferred.

events.title: BlueWallet Mobile released by 2018
events.description: BlueWallet's official source history records a store-versioned mobile build during 2018, establishing the mobile product as released by that year.
events.notes: Year precision only. The reviewed source history establishes a store/release lineage in 2018 but does not establish a defensible exact initial public-release day.

evidence.title: BlueWallet — Bitcoin wallet for iOS and Android
evidence.notes: Current first-party source for self-custody mobile-wallet status and device-local keys.

evidence.title: Sunsetting Lndhub.io
evidence.notes: Primary announcement establishing the May 31, 2023 hosted Lightning-service shutdown, regular Bitcoin-wallet exclusion, and continued self-hosted LndHub support.

evidence.title: BlueWallet v7.0.9
evidence.notes: Official BlueWallet release notes explicitly list the operational-security preferred Electrum server persistence/reset issue #7532 as fixed in v7.0.9.

evidence.title: BlueWallet PR #7546 — Electrum preferred server persistence fix
evidence.notes: Merged official BlueWallet source-code change for issue #7532. The patch changes Electrum preferred-server/reset/history behavior and settings refresh logic.

evidence.title: BlueWallet store version 1.2.0
evidence.notes: Official BlueWallet source history showing a 2018 store-versioned mobile build with BlueWallet iOS bundle/build metadata. Used for year-level launch chronology, not as proof of the exact initial release day.
